source.label: Source
source.none: Not playable on any enabled source

recommend.profileEmpty: Play a few songs to build your profile
recommend.sourceSubtitle: Recommendations from {{source}} itself (not the local profile)

confirm.clearQueueDesc: This clears the play queue and keeps only the current track.
confirm.clearRecentDesc: This deletes all recently played records. It cannot be undone.
confirm.clearDownloadsDesc: This removes all finished download records.
confirm.deletePlaylistDesc: “{{name}}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.uninstallPluginDesc: “{{name}}” will be uninstalled and no longer used for merging or fallback.
confirm.compatDesc: “{{name}}” will only be allowed to reach: {{hosts}}. Every other host is rejected, so the plugin may fail if it needs another one; restoring compatibility mode requires importing it again.
confirm.removeLocalDesc: “{{name}}” will be removed from the library. The file on disk is kept.
confirm.removeDownloadDesc: The download record for “{{name}}” will be removed.
confirm.removeSubscriptionDesc: Subscription “{{name}}” and its cached index will be removed; installed plugins are unaffected.

skin.jsonPlaceholder: Paste the contents of a .gently-skin.json here (same rule as plugins: you bring the source)
skin.pathHint: Paste a path directly, or pick a file with the picker. Validation and install happen in the local core.

ranking.title: Rankings
ranking.subtitle: Browse by source category
ranking.noGroupsHint: The source does not implement the rankings API, or no source is installed yet

local.title: Local Music
local.subtitle: {{count}} songs
local.empty: No local music yet — paste a folder path above and scan
local.scanHint: One folder per line. Only audio extensions (mp3/flac/m4a/m4s/mp4/aac/ogg/opus/wav…) are indexed; files whose size is unchanged are not re-read; files without readable tags are still indexed (title falls back to the file name). Paste the path directly — a native file picker needs an extra desktop plugin that is not in the current dependency set.
local.scanResult: Last scan: {{scanned}} files, {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{removed}} removed, {{skipped}} skipped, {{unreadable}} unreadable, {{ignored}} non-audio
local.scanNeedsDesktop: Scanning local folders needs the desktop app (the browser preview shows sample data).

plugin.coreHint: Plugins are imported by you on this machine; this app ships and recommends no online sources.
plugin.browserNotice: Previewing in a browser: plugin management needs the desktop app (this page shows mock data).
plugin.pathHint: Paste a path: a .js file, a folder containing plugin.json, or a .zip (one extra folder inside the archive is fine). There is no “Browse…” button — a native file picker needs an extra desktop plugin that is not in the current dependency set.
plugin.pastePlaceholder: Paste the .js plugin here (it should start with // @id …)
plugin.compatLabel: Import in compatibility mode (MusicFree / LX ecosystem plugins)
plugin.compatHint: For CommonJS plugins without header metadata. Compatibility mode may reach any public host and is weaker than the normal plugin ABI; off by default.
plugin.compatWarning: Compatibility mode: this plugin may reach any public host (loopback and private networks are still blocked), is not limited to a host allowlist, and is weaker than the normal plugin ABI.
plugin.compatNoHosts: No hosts observed yet: use the plugin once (search or play), then come back to restrict it.
plugin.consent: I have reviewed the permissions and origin above, and I confirm I may access the content this plugin provides.
plugin.permissionNetwork: Network access (only the hosts the plugin declares)
plugin.permissionNetworkCompat: Network access (compatibility mode has no host allowlist: any public host)
plugin.replaces: This replaces the installed plugin with the same id
plugin.installedEmpty: No plugins imported yet — the app ships no built-in sources; import one yourself.
plugin.disclaimer: Plugins are provided by third parties and are unrelated to this software; please make sure you may access their content.
plugin.needSource: Please provide the plugin content or URL first
plugin.oauthTitle: Third-party sign-in (after install, your browser opens that domain's consent page)
plugin.authTitle: Third-party sign-in (OAuth 2.0, endpoints declared by this plugin)
plugin.authSignOutConfirmDesc: Deletes the token stored on this machine; features that need sign-in (such as favorites) stop working immediately.
plugin.authWaiting: Waiting for the browser to finish…
plugin.authFailed: Authorization did not complete (see the log for details); you can try again
plugin.authEndpointHint: The consent page opens in your system browser; its address comes from this plugin's manifest — the app ships no third-party addresses of its own, so a different source means different endpoints.
plugin.authStoredHint: The token is stored only in the system credential manager; it never reaches the UI, the database or the logs.
plugin.authRestartHint: The system credential store is unavailable, so the token falls back to in-process storage — you will need to authorize again after a restart.
plugin.authNoPkceHint: This plugin does not use PKCE: a public client is more exposed if the authorization code is intercepted. Worth reporting to the plugin author.
plugin.authDesktopOnly: Authorization needs the local core of the desktop build (unavailable in browser preview).
plugin.credentialNone: This plugin declares no credential fields
plugin.credentialEmpty: Fill in at least one credential first
plugin.credentialStoredHint: Credentials go into the system credential manager (not the app database or logs) and survive restarts; they are only handed to the plugin that declared each key.
plugin.credentialRestartHint: The system credential store is unavailable, so credentials fall back to in-process storage — you will need to re-enter them after a restart (see the diagnostics card in Settings).
plugin.configHint: A JSON object; current revision {{revision}} (a save conflicts if it changed elsewhere — reload to get the latest)
plugin.configObjectOnly: Config must be a JSON object
plugin.configConflict: Config changed elsewhere — reload before saving
plugin.subscriptionHint: A subscription is a repository index (repository.json): enter the address once, then pick plugins from it. The app ships no subscription addresses and never adds one for you.
plugin.subscriptionAdded: Subscription added (a failed first fetch shows the reason; the old index is kept)
plugin.catalogEmpty: No installable entries yet (refresh the index first)
plugin.title: Plugins
plugin.subtitle: Music sources are plugins — {{count}} installed

search.hint: Type a keyword to start searching
search.noSource: No source is installed, so there is nothing to search

collection.title: Album / playlist
collection.notFound: Not found, or this source does not provide it

nowPlaying.searchLyricsHint: Looks for lyrics across your installed sources and shows which source and track each result belongs to. Pick one to replace the current lyrics.
nowPlaying.searchLyricsEmpty: No lyrics found — try another keyword.
nowPlaying.searchLyricsNoCore: Searching lyrics needs the desktop core; the browser preview only shows the UI.
nowPlaying.searchLyricsTimedOut: {{count}} sources timed out; results may be incomplete
nowPlaying.lyricsOffsetHint: If the lyrics run early or late, correct by ±0.5 s; remembered per track.

setting.title: Settings
setting.subtitle: Appearance, language and data source
setting.confirmHint: When off, delete / clear / uninstall actions run immediately
setting.diagUnavailableHint: The browser preview uses mock data; the desktop build serves the library, playback and local files from the local core
setting.diagCredentialsOs: Using the system credential store (survives restarts)
setting.diagCredentialsMemory: Fell back to in-process storage: re-enter after a restart
setting.downloadDirPlaceholder: Leave empty for the default folder
setting.downloadDirHint: Empty = the downloads folder under the data directory. A custom folder must already exist; the core rejects missing folders with a clear reason.
setting.downloadConcurrentHint: Extra tracks wait in a queue instead of competing for bandwidth.
setting.whenDownloadQualityIsMissing: When the preferred quality is unavailable
setting.cacheHint: Only tracks you played and lyrics you used are cached; offline playback prefers the local cache. Oldest entries are removed when the limit is exceeded.
setting.cacheClearDesc: The cache is rebuilt on demand (played songs need to be played online again to be cached); downloaded files are not affected.
setting.cacheUnavailable: Cache management needs the desktop core; the browser preview has no local cache.
